title: Release Dependency Gazetteer & Mitigation Playbook for Cross-Functional Roadmaps
creator: Marcus Lee
description:
Problem: Cross-team release plans frequently surface hidden blockers late in the cycle (security signoffs, infra capacity, UX alignment). This increases delay friction and causes last-minute scope cuts. Goal: Build a lightweight, searchable "gazetteer" of roadmap dependencies (by release and initiative) plus an actionable mitigation playbook that engineering, design, security and infra teams can use during planning cycles and cutover windows. Outcome: Reduce undetected dependency slippage by 50% for prioritized initiatives and provide automated signals and runbooks to accelerate resolution. Implementation approach:
- Define canonical schema for dependency entries: owner, team, type (blocking/async), SLA target, risk score, detection signals, mitigation steps, escalation path, related artifacts (PRs/docs).
- Integrate with Linear/Console so PMs can attach dependency entries to initiatives and get automated reminders/health checks.
- Build a small Console view (heatmap + list) and an exportable CSV for exec reviews.
- Create templated playbooks per dependency class (security review, infra quota, design QA) and on-call escalation flows.
- Surface dependency health signals from CI (failing e2e), infra metrics (quota warnings), and security scans (open issues).
- Run pilot with 3 initiatives across infra, runtime, and console teams during Cycle 2025-W06.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical dependency schema documented and accepted by Eng/Design/Security/Infra
Console: searchable dependency list with filters by release, owner, and risk
Automated health signal ingestion for at least 3 signal sources (CI, infra quotas, security scan)
Playbook templates for top 4 dependency types (security, infra, UX, data) published in Confluence
Pilot completed on 3 initiatives with retro and measurable signal reduction
Escalation paths mapped with on-call owners and SLA targets in Linear
